factorRatings.note: The Seattle Times profiled the Renton original of this wood-fired chain -- same Woodstone-oven recipes and specialty pies (like the Goatsmary: chili oil, goat cheese, rosemary, roasted cashews, parmesan, $16 for a 12-inch) that the Magnolia storefront serves under the same name and menu -- praising inventive topping combinations under the headline 'Pizza perfection with a side of science fiction.'

The Daily (UW's student paper) covered the April 10, 2026 opening on the Ave -- late-night hours to 2:30am Fri/Sat and over 1,000 opening-day transactions -- and The Infatuation describes 'standard New York-style slices' in a Heaven-and-Hell-themed bar setting with a 21+ area, while explicitly noting its writers hadn't yet tasted the food; a distinctive late-night bar concept without an established critical verdict on the pizza itself.
